title: Morning Brief — Monday, 21 September 2026
description: Today: fuel prices climb again as Middle East disruption hits oil markets and Adelaide edges Brisbane in a fiery AFLW clash; Queensland police search for a missing Greenvale man as regional tourism and agriculture operators raise migration concerns; and the Gold Coast Suns rout Essendon while the city gears up for a busy spring events calendar. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
